title: Blow-ups preserve Radon convergence for tests supported in the blown-up domain (steps 0(a)–(b); printed 'η_{ξ,λ#}V_i → η_{ξ,λ#}V for each fixed λ')
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, and V_i (i ∈ ℕ), V n-varifolds on U (so U is open) with V_i → V as Radon measures on G_n(U) (Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V: ∫ f d(V_i.domainMeasure) → ∫ f d(V.domainMeasure) for every f ∈ C_c(U × G(N,n))). Let ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and F ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) such that ξ + t·y ∈ U for every (y, S) ∈ tsupport F. Then ∫ F d(V_i)_{ξ,t} → ∫ F dV_{ξ,t} as i → ∞, where V'_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V' ξ t = ofReal(t^{-n})·(V'.measure)_#[(z, S) ↦ (t^{-1}(z − ξ), S)].
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure (Vi i) ξ t)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure V ξ t)))
